declaration.visibility: Every generated noisy observation must have positive depth and lie inside the image
declaration.implementation: Modelica owns synthetic camera geometry/visibility and all estimator updates; Python owns scenario generation, orchestration and independent offline scoring
declaration.bias_model: Constant random biases, zero random-walk spectral density
declaration.gates: Disabled; acceptance and absence of duplicate/unavailable fusion are checked
declaration.consistency: Raw full15 covariance must be symmetric and Cholesky-positive on every row; NEES15 and dimension-specific NIS are reported without a statistical certification threshold
declaration.scope: Sequential fixed-known-map visual aiding; no live uncertain map, retained-reference correlations, feature association, camera rendering, transport delay, loop closure or native EKF comparison
